jei.more_mooblooms.info.pool: Flowers: %s. Each of the three spots on its back and head grows its own pick.
jei.more_mooblooms.info.feed: Feed a cow %s: each one has a %s%% chance to turn it into this moobloom (babies too).
jei.more_mooblooms.info.shear: Shear a grown moobloom for the flowers it is carrying. It stays a moobloom, bare, and grows a fresh set after eating grass, like a sheep.
jei.more_mooblooms.info.bare: Shearing a bare moobloom turns it back into a cow.
jei.more_mooblooms.info.bare_drops: Shearing a bare moobloom turns it back into a cow and drops three flowers, picked by the odds above.
jei.more_mooblooms.info.breed: Breed and grow it with %s instead of wheat. Any two mooblooms can breed: two of the same kind make the same kind, other pairs make a random moobloom unless Moobloom Breeding lists the pair.
jei.more_mooblooms.info.never_random: Never comes from a random calf.
